reviews.comment: The course had no exams, and most of the grade came from activities that typically involved watching videos or attending and observing events outside of class. Attendance was essential for success in the course.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is awesome! His lectures are very interesting and he is really funny. There is no final and the assignments are very manageable. Would definitely recommend taking this course with him, I learned a lot and had fun.

as a stem major who took this for core credit, i really enjoyed his class! i can tell he's involved with his field. no exams and he made mondays entirely async! it does add up in assignments, but i really appreciated it bc i could actually listen in his class instead of panic notetaking. attendance pts, but he made his time worth it :)

His lectures are interesting, and he explains everything really well. Participation is mainly what you are graded on so it's very important to go to class and add to the conversation. It's a super easy class and it's very informative.

Professor Winking was great to take for Anth210. I took the class for my anthropology minor and cultural discourse credit. His lectures were engaging and he was accessible outside of class with his office hours and zoom meetings. He provides a study guide which is super helpful and he'll explain anything on it you don't understand.

Daily lectures with response points for participation credit. Clear grader. Two short response essays. Responds to emails fairly quickly. Straight forward exams with parts of the final repeated questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Winking is a great professor—his lectures are engaging, and he clearly cares about the material. Homework and writing assignments are manageable, but participation matters, so don't skip class. Exams cover both lectures and the textbook, so keeping up with the readings is key if you're aiming for an A.

I loved this class it was super interesting and he was super respectful and openminded. The class was basically an easy A. The slides aren't that detailed but the study guides prep you really well for the exams. He was super nice and open to conversation about any topic and fostered discussions well. Participation is graded so beware.

Winking is a naturally funny man, and it shows through his lectures. He is a very respectful orator and listener, a valuable skill for a class that covers topics from gender to indigeneity, diversity to political systems, etc.  There is an online free textbook you are supposed to read, but you can get by with skimming it. Very personable and fun.

Attendance through participations questions. His lecture slides are not very detailed, so take your own notes. Easy enough if you study the exam reviews. He holds Zoom office hours before exams that are helpful. Grades are 3 homeworks, 3 150-250 word "essays" that are essentially completion, and 3 exams.

Dr. Winking is very passionate about his work and a good lecturer. His tests are a bit tricky, but he does provide detailed study guides for every test, so it's not a huge deal. I think all the bad reviews are just offended by his personal opinions lol. He's a perfectly fine prof.

He makes the 200 level class unrealistically difficult by grading the exams harshly with his own opinion. Very hard to pay attention or pretend to be interested, lectures are worthless as he just reads off the slides projected on the wall every single class period. I finished with a low A and I would not recommend anyone to take this professor.
The nicest professor ever! you can tell that he genuinely cares for Anthro, and just wants you to have fun too! no exams just an assignment due every week!

Lectures are super interesting and Winking is super passionate about Anth. There are no tests and only class once a week. The assignments can honestly be pretty annoying and time-consuming however it is really easy to get an A with a little bit of effort. I would definitely recommend it for an easy language philosophy & culture.

I LOVE this prof! He's got the greatest dad humor which made classes entertaining. We did fun lecture related activities most every class which really made going to class fun. Lectures are good and well paced, gives a straight forward review sheet for the exams which tell you everything you need to know (uses class b4 test as review day)

Jeff is a great guy. His lectures are genuinely interesting, and I would actually look forward to my 8am class with him. Pay attention during lecture and take decent notes, as every test was open note and internet. Because of this, his tests are tricky, and I always thought I did better on them than I actually did. Overall, this was a fun, easy A.

You'll have some long videos to watch occasionally, but other than that the work isn't too hard. There are normally questions to answer in e-campus before class from the textbook but I just ctrl f and found the answer almost immediately. The exams were open note, open google, you just couldn't talk with anyone. He's a GREAT professor. 1000/10

Took Dr. Winking this Fall online and he was great. He posts his lectures online so if you miss the zoom live class you can re-watch the class anytime. If you attend the zoom class live he gives you attendance points! He allows open book, open notes, open access to everything for your exams! Watch the lectures and you'll pass! Easy grader too.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very tricky exams and final is from all semester. He makes you waste money in the clicker and then do pop quizzes with it. Boring lectures since he talks so monotone and changes slides quickly. No curves or make up assignment. He makes the class hard just because it's a 200 level, so he can challenge ya'll. No clear grading criteria at all!!! BAD!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very chill, took for ICC, easy A, just don't miss too much class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Winking is hilarious! He's a great guy and even better instructor. Although the course content tends to be dense he provides clear, relatable examples and an excellent classroom environment through his chillness. Very dad humored! I highly recommend everyone to take a class with him!

Winking is a great prof, he knows what he's talking about & tries his best to make it entertaining. At times it can get boring b/c the lectures can feel drawn out. He does daily iclicker quizzes but they're easy if you payed attention. The tests aren't bad & he has extra office hours before them for you to go and ask him questions about the review

He is hilarious and makes lectures interesting and fun to listen to. He takes attendance via iClicker points/quizzes (which you have to get right in order to get the point) at the end of each class, so basically show up and you'll do fine. There are 3 tests and 3 homework assignments which are easy. He is very caring and relatable as well
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Winking is super nice and tries to make his lectures as entertaining as possible. He does clicker quizzes every class so don't skip, some of them are worth bonus points. There are 3 homework assignments that are super easy and 3 exams, including the final. The textbook isn't necessary but it is helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: A small group of study abroad got 3 B's and 2 C's. He didn't return all the graded quizzes/exams or the correct answers to us. Graded subjectively. A student who was failing ended up getting an A. If he likes you, you get good grade and vice versa. Thought he were cool, but it doesn't seem like that.

If you can take ANTH (370/now 270) abroad, take it with Dr. Winking. He's a fun and relatable prof, and his lectures are interesting and engaging. There were 5 quizzes in class for which you only need to pay attention to do well. 4 "think pieces" do not take long to write. He gives you plenty of time on the final paper. Very accessible for help.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Winking is a really fun prof! His tests aren't too bad and he has a review day in class to help you out. He's really relatable and i enjoyed going to class.

Makes the class very interesting. Homework pretty straightforward, grading can be iffy but overall he is willing to discuss anything with you. Book was useful but not imperative. Tests can be sightly confusing but go to class and pretty easy. Clicker questions count to overall grade.

Very passionate about his field and super funny; definitely keeps you interested. Attendance is part of the grade, but he makes lectures enjoyable and also gives you almost everything you'll be tested over.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He really knows how to explain the points he is trying to get across and finds a way to make the class interesting. There is very minimal homework but the test are a bit difficult (not impossible). I really loved taking this course and made me think about minoring in Anth.
Clicker quizzes, not too hard. Overall great dude. You won't be bored. I'm the ultimate slacker and just by going to class I'm able to retain most of the information. He teaches very well.

Winking is the best! He's hilarious and really keeps lectures engaging. You need to read and show up to class, he takes daily clicker quizzes. The tests aren't bad as long as you pay attention in lecture, read, and watch the videos he gives you. He is super understanding and tries to help you as much as he can. Highly recommend this class!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor!! Must study, must read/understand the information. He gives a review, but you have to know it inside/out, or you will not pass. He's very accessible, so if you have questions, ASK! He has been everywhere and has a first-hand experience with what he teaches. I would definitely take him again.

Basically, go to class and you'll get at least a C. He takes attendance every class so if you don't go it'll hurt you. His lectures are interesting because he's done a lot of traveling and research so his stories are firsthand. Exams are kinda hard but as long as you study you'll be fine.

Professor Winking is amazing! He is very intelligent and  passionate about what he teaches. You can tell he is incredibly knowledgeable about it. However, the tests are tough-lots of application. If you pay attention in class and learn how to use the knowledge instead of just memorising it, you'll be fine. Easy essay grader.

He was an AMAZING teacher. You could tell how passionate he was each lecture. He never went over his lecture time but he didn't wast any of it either. For tests you need to go to class and keep up the reading and you will make an A on the exam no doubt. Homework assignments were easy and fun, not a harsh grader. TAKE THIS CLASS

Dr. Winking's class was definitely not "easy." His test reviews don't match the exams, so if you think just memorizing the review will give you an A, you're wrong. Learn the review, but be able to explain with great detail what's on it! While Dr. Winking's lectures tend to feel long, you can tell he's very passionate about what he's teaching.
